Subject: Team Albany at Uni Games

Team Albany, our Uni Games team had great success at the University
Games last week coming home with the Small Campus Trophy!  Our team of
87 competed in Volleyball; Beach Volleyball; Golf; Fencing; Surfing;
Lawn Bowls; Tennis; Squash; Soccer; Touch Rugby; Ultimate Frisbee;
Netball and Basketball.

Achievements on the sports field included:
Jenna Hirst - Gold in Golf
Seb Furneaux - Bronze in Surfing
Nic McHugh - Bronze in Squash
Volleyball Team - Bronze
Fabrice Toalshoa - Tournament Team Award
Semi Madar - Tournament Team Award

We also won shield points in Basketball; Beach Volleyball; Lawn Bowls
and Netball.

The team had a great time and I'm happy to report they were generally
well behaved.  It is extremely disappointing the bad press that the
games have received over the last couple of days but when put into
perspective there were only two small groups who got out of hand while
around 2,000 students did not cause any problems, instead they brought
in a lot of money to the Rotorua economy and life to the town.  Our team
were NOT involved in any "hotel rampage."  They showed great team spirit
and made friends with people around Rotorua including the people hosting
their accommodation.  

Well Done Team Albany!

Adele Adamson
Clubs Development Officer
Albany Students' Association Inc
Massey University Albany

Auckland
